quote_basis: Higgsfield estimate_video_cost / estimate_image_cost, 5-second 9:16 clip, default resolution. Quotes spend nothing. Credit-to-dollar rate depends on the Higgsfield plan and is not stated here.
rule: Best model thinks, cheap model renders. Build each ad mostly from stills; animate only the beats that need motion.

think.use_for: hooks, scripts, comedy timing, lyrics, shot prompts, carousel copy, QA
think.model: Claude (the Wizard Agent itself, best available model)

still.use_for: every still frame, carousel slide art, start frames for clips

clip_draft.use_for: drafts, previews, simple motion (zoom, pan, small action)

clip_standard.use_for: default final motion beats, image-to-video from a still

clip_hero.use_for: one premium shot per ad, only when the client approves the spend

talking_head.use_for: client clone / presenter speaking to camera (lip-sync)
talking_head.note: Not quoted: the estimate needs a real voice recording (audio_references). Quote it per job before generating.

text_only.use_for: kinetic text, captions over a color or blurred background, assembled in the edit

carousel.use_for: turning a template's slides into an editable branded carousel
carousel.model: Canva (generate-design / autofill-design with the client's brand kit)
carousel.note: Canva cost depends on the user's Canva plan, not Higgsfield credits.

budgets.note: Validator enforces these. Credits are computed at the template's own tiers, with every clip counted as one 5s unit.
